questions.q_en:
Select the letter-cluster that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

STRAWBERRY, PWRAWBERRY, STODWBERRY, ?, STRAWBBURY, STRAWBEROB
questions.solution_en:
Two letters are changed in each step starting from the left end. The remaining letters are same as given in the first word.

STRAWBERRY: S - 3 = P, T + 3 = W: PWRAWBERRY

STRAWBERRY: R - 3 = O, A + 3 = D: STODWBERRY

STRAWBERRY: W - 3 = T, B + 3 = E: STRATEERRY

STRAWBERRY: E - 3 = B, R + 3 = U: STRAWBBURY

STRAWBERRY: R - 3 = O, Y + 3 = B: STRAWBEROB

So, the missing word is STRATEERRY.

STRAWBERRY: E - 3 = B, R + 3 = U: STRAWBBURY
